app.title: Stowly
app.subtitle: 3D packing workbench
app.backendFailed: The solver service failed to start

bins.name: Name
bins.maxStackDensityHelp: Heaviest stack weight per floor area (boxstacks only)
bins.openSidesHelp: Which faces of the container are open; used by the 3D view and to reason about loading. The solver's unloading constraints always assume the door at the x-max (or y-max) end.
bins.empty: No containers yet. Pick a container, truck or pallet from the presets.

items.name: Name
items.empty: No cargo yet. Add rows, pick from presets, or import a CSV/Excel cargo list.

stackingHelp.maxStack: Most items in one stack containing this type; blank = unlimited
stackingHelp.maxWeightAbove: Heaviest load allowed on top of one item; blank = unlimited
stackingHelp.nestingHeight: How deep the item above sinks into this one; the stack height shrinks by it
stackingHelp.group: Unloading order group: 0 is unloaded first and packed nearest the door; used with the unloading constraint in Solver

items.stackingOnly: Stacking parameters (max in stack, load above, nesting, unload group) are used by the boxstacks solver only; the current solver is box, so these columns are hidden.
items.stackingUpright: boxstacks places items upright only: rotation "any" is treated as "upright".

settings.solverHelp: box: free 3D packing, any rotation, no support constraint (items may float); boxstacks: upright stacks of identical cargo with stacking limits, load above, floor load and unloading constraints
settings.unloadingHelp: boxstacks only. Upstream assumes the door at the x-max (or y-max) end and unloads groups in increasing order: group 0 first, packed nearest the door. "Only x/y movements": cargo unloaded later never blocks cargo unloaded earlier; "increasing x/y": groups form consecutive segments along that axis.
settings.unloadingBoxOnly: The box solver has no unloading constraints or stacking model

unloadingOptions.only-x-movements: only x movements to unload (door at x max)
unloadingOptions.only-y-movements: only y movements to unload (door at y max)
unloadingOptions.increasing-x: groups in segments along x (door at x max)
unloadingOptions.increasing-y: groups in segments along y (door at y max)

objectiveHelp.bin-packing: Pack everything into as few containers as possible
objectiveHelp.knapsack: Fill one container with the highest total value (value defaults to volume)
objectiveHelp.variable-sized-bin-packing: Pack everything, choosing the cheapest mix of container types

problems.no-bins: At least one container is needed
problems.no-items: At least one cargo row is needed
problems.bad-time-limit: The time limit must be positive
problems.bad: Some rows have invalid dimensions or counts

settings.summary: Cargo volume {{items}} m³, container capacity {{bins}} m³ ({{ratio}}%)
settings.timeAutoHint: The time limit and the stall-stop rule follow the cargo size and the algorithm upstream will run; the wait scales with the time of the last improvement, so most solves end well before the limit.
settings.recommendation: first solution in ~{{latency}} s, limit {{timeLimit}} s; stop after {{ratio}}× the time of the last improvement without a new one (at least {{patience}} s, not before {{after}} s)
settings.recommendationUnavailable: no estimate (backend unavailable or project incomplete)
settings.manualHint: Pre-filled with the recommendation; adjust as you like.
settings.stopOff: Leave empty to end on the time limit only (the ratio needs it)
settings.calibrationNone: machine speed not calibrated yet; the first solve calibrates it
settings.svcWarning: Multi-bin boxstacks knapsack / variable-sized bin packing runs a sequential per-bin value correction (SVC): nothing before its first full pass, which can take tens of seconds. Automatic mode budgets that pass, the machine-speed factor only ever lengthens it, and a run that ends without a solution is extended once.
settings.capWarning: The recommended limit hit the 600 s cap: this size and shape is beyond what the current upstream algorithm handles quickly.
settings.stopRatioHelp: Stop once no improvement has arrived for this many times the time of the last improvement; leave empty for the fixed seconds alone

presets.title: Built-in presets
presets.hint: Typical published interior dimensions; check the equipment plate or registration for the real unit.

result.title: Result
result.none: Not solved yet. Fill in containers and cargo, then press Solve.
result.hover: Hover to inspect, click to select

viewer.orderBoxHelp: The box solver has no support constraint: this is the order the search inserted items, not a loading order. Items may float, and an item may appear before the one below it.
viewer.orderStacksHelp: boxstacks lists stack by stack from the floor up; every item rests on the previous one or the floor, so this can be used as the loading order.
viewer.floatingHelp: Placements with nothing directly underneath in the final solution, outlined in red in the 3D view. The upstream box model allows them; check by hand or use boxstacks.
viewer.gravityHelp: The dark grid plate is the container floor and the arrow beside it points along gravity; cargo on the grid rests on the floor, cargo outlined in red has nothing underneath.
viewer.unavailable: 3D view unavailable: this environment cannot create a WebGL context. Tables, solving and exports still work.

import.title: Import
import.hint: Supported: Stowly project JSON, CSV/XLSX cargo lists (headers recognised in English and Chinese: name / length / width / height / quantity / weight), ESICUP thpack/BR text instances, PackingSolver items.csv + bins.csv.
import.unit: Length unit used in the file
import.instance: Instance index inside a thpack file (from 0)
import.ok: Imported {{items}} cargo types and {{bins}} container types

progress.title: Solve progress
progress.waitingFirst: waiting for the first solution (about {{latency}} s)…
progress.current: best so far: {{items}} items · {{bins}} bins · last improvement {{ago}} s ago
progress.finishedUnimproved: ended early: no improvement after {{since}} s ({{silence}} s of silence)
progress.extended: the first pass did not finish within {{first}} s; the limit was extended automatically to {{timeLimit}} s
progress.finishedSinglePass: no pass finished within {{timeLimit}} s: the {{path}} path has no solution before its first full pass. Raise the time limit in manual mode, or reduce containers / cargo.
